title: Dinosaurs
story: Big lizards, bubbling lava and a little digging fun.

cards.name: Rock Hammer
cards.subject: A geologist's hammer with a square flat head on one side and a long pointed tip on the other, fixed on a straight wooden handle with a grip at the end.
cards.hero_colors: steel grey head, wood brown handle, yellow grip

cards.name: Lava Lamp
cards.subject: A tall tapered glass lava lamp with several red wax blobs floating inside, a round metal base and a small metal cap on top.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, red wax, gold base and cap

cards.name: Ammonite
cards.subject: A fossil ammonite shell: a perfectly round flat coiled spiral with evenly spaced ribs, in grey-tan stone.
cards.hero_colors: tan and grey stone, small cream highlights

cards.name: Volcano Model
cards.subject: A science-fair volcano model: a brown cone with a round crater at the top, bright red-orange lava foam bubbling over the rim and running down one side, standing on a small square board.
